records.title: Security scanner: real scan-VM end-to-end validation
records.justification: The remaining acceptance must be measured on a dedicated security-scan VM (Docker, a buildx builder on the filtered vs-build network, vs-build-network.service, the claude CLI and an ssh docker_host) that the owner has not provisioned. No coding agent can provision it or run a real scan end to end, and no unit test or synthetic fixture substitutes for the reboot, network-isolation and cleanup observations.
resource_prerequisites: A dedicated scan VM provisioned by the owner
A buildx builder on the filtered vs-build network
The claude CLI installed on the scan VM
An ssh docker_host reachable from the dashboard
acceptance_criteria: `setup-build-network.sh --apply` plus the boot unit leave `/run/vs-build/vs-build.ok` matching the live network id after a reboot.
From the build network, RFC1918, CGNAT, link-local and the host's INPUT are unreachable, and public DNS and registries work.

A real scan of one pilot repo (Tools, UpstreamDrift or AffineDrift) completes. Its record must show: phase A built with a digest recorded; phase B ran in a `--network=none` container; findings were stored as `new`; the verifier ran with a different model.
Queued CI jobs abort a running scan within one `poll_s`.
After success, abort and cancel, no `fleet.security.scan=1` containers or images remain.
The Security page shows the pilot contracts as valid.
reopen_criteria: The owner has provisioned the scan VM with every resource prerequisite and applied the host setup in docs/operations/security-scanning.md.
records.notes: Part of epic #2566 (fleet security scanner). The q5 panel verdict listed a VM e2e launch test as a should-fix follow-up. Runbook: docs/operations/security-scanning.md (lands with PR #2612). No measurement has been taken.

records.title: Fleet-decision panel preset: live hub run with Barb turnover
records.justification: Unit tests and docs cover preset availability, repo grounding snapshots and turnover failure tolerance. The issue's remaining acceptance is one live Staff Console panel run on a hub where antigravity, codex and claude read-only seats are enabled, proving per-seat availability flags and a Barb turnover note after completion.
resource_prerequisites: Runner Dashboard hub with staff panel providers antigravity, codex and claude enabled
Operator session with staff.read and panel launch permissions
Repository_Management checkout for Barb turnover scripts
acceptance_criteria: Launch preset `fleet-decision` from Staff Console; each seat shows correct provider/model and unavailable seats are marked, not swapped.
Panel completes at least one round with repo grounding enabled; snapshot has no `.git` directory.
Barb turnover note is posted on completion (failure to post must not fail the panel run).
reopen_criteria: Hub providers or panel preset definitions change materially after this catalog entry.
records.notes: Code/doc slices merged (#3623 and follow-ons). Close #2511 after this live run is recorded with receipts.
